title: Gepant treAtments: EffectIveNess and tolERability (GAINER)
official: Effectiveness and Tolerability of Rimegepant as Acute Migraine Treatment: a Prospective, Multicentric, Cohort Study (GAINER)
summary: The purpose of this prospective and multicentric study is to evaluate the effectiveness and tolerability of rimegepant as acute migraine treatment in a cohort of episodic or chronic migraine patients.
